target.title: [codex] Refresh Swift CI and library artifacts
target.body:
## Summary

- Remove the DocC catalog from Commander runtime resources, avoiding a generated resource bundle/accessor while preserving documentation generation.
- Refresh CI to Swift 6.3.3 and Ubuntu 24.04, and make Linux build/tests required again.
- Pin checkout/setup actions to the exact current release commits and correct the documented Swift 6.0 package requirement.
- Restore the unreleased changelog for the current parser fix and artifact correction.

## Validation

- `swift build --scratch-path <fresh> --build-tests`
- `swift test --scratch-path <fresh>` (16 tests passed)
- Fresh build artifact scan: no `Commander*.bundle`
- `swift package --disable-sandbox generate-documentation --target Commander ...` (archive generated with Commander articles)
- `actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml`
- Ruby YAML parse
- Behavior-validator contract: 4 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked
- Autoreview: clean; no accepted/actionable findings

## Dependency/security audit

- `swift-docc-plugin` remains current at 1.5.0; upstream is active.
- Transitive `swift-docc-symbolkit` remains resolver-current at 1.0.0; upstream is active.
- `actions/checkout` pinned to v7.0.0 commit.
- `SwiftyLab/setup-swift` pinned to v1.14.0 commit.
- GitHub Dependabot: zero open security alerts.
- Public model identifier gate: PASS; no model-bearing surfaces in this change.

Risk: low. Package metadata/CI/docs only; no Commander runtime source changed. Linux is intentionally promoted from advisory to required, so CI will prove the upgraded toolchain/runner combination before merge.
